note: Japanese night. 事 si6 first (the owl never forgets), then six old stragglers, then な行+は行 recap, then new ま行 + ら行 and 10 words. Watch め/ぬ, る/ろ, れ/ね. 写三遍，念出声。

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not rising like 試 si3.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (low, flat, no rise)

tasks.title: NHK hiragana chart · tap ま–も and ら–ろ, repeat each
Read without romaji first (only kana you know)

lines.text: くるま は くろい
lines.translation: the car is black · 车是黑的 (は = wa)
the spring sky · 春天的天空

lines.text: みせ は まち に ある
lines.translation: the shop is in town · 店在镇上

lines.text: あめ の ひ は さむい
lines.translation: rainy days are cold · 下雨天很冷

tasks.prompt: Write まみむめも らりるれろ ×3 each, saying each aloud (~5 min). Then read the 5 lines twice, slow then normal speed. Pairs to watch: め vs ぬ (ぬ curls at the end), る vs ろ (る has the loop), れ vs ね (ね loops, れ kicks out). The r-sound is a light tongue tap, not an English r.
tasks.script:
ma mi mu me mo · ra ri ru re ro
くるま は くろい (kuruma wa kuroi)
はる の そら (haru no sora)
みせ は まち に ある (mise wa machi ni aru)
しろい ねこ (shiroi neko)
あめ の ひ は さむい (ame no hi wa samui)

questions.explain: る ru has a loop at the bottom; ろ ro is open.
め me has no curl at the end; ぬ nu curls.
く ku + る ru + ま ma.
そら sora = sky 空; town = まち, white = しろ.
れ re kicks out at the end; ね ne loops.
